worlds.name: Garden
worlds.blurb: Plan a route with forward and turn blocks. Left and right are the robot's own left and right.

worlds.name: Factory
worlds.blurb: Repeat blocks do the same thing again and again.

worlds.name: Space
worlds.blurb: Collect gems and build your own Function F.

levels.title: Straight ahead
levels.tip: Tap Forward four times, then press Run.

levels.title: Round the corner
levels.tip: Turn Left is the robot's left, not yours. Facing right, its left points up.

levels.title: Turn the other way
levels.tip: Turn Right is the robot's right. Facing down, its right points to the left.

levels.title: Around the rock
levels.tip: The robot cannot go through rocks. Plan a way around.

levels.title: Garden zigzag
levels.tip: Use Step to follow the robot one block at a time.

levels.title: Turn around
levels.tip: Two turns in a row turn the robot right around.

levels.title: Mind the rocks
levels.tip: Look at which way the robot faces before you turn.

levels.title: Flower steps
levels.tip: Zigzag steps: forward, turn, forward, turn.

levels.title: Find the gap
levels.tip: Look for the gap in the rocks.

levels.title: Garden maze
levels.tip: Take your time. Try a few blocks, then Run and watch.

levels.title: Long road
levels.tip: Repeat does the same blocks again and again. Put Forward inside Repeat.

levels.title: Two long roads
levels.tip: You can use more than one Repeat block.

levels.title: Staircase
levels.tip: A staircase is the same four blocks again and again: forward, left, forward, right.

levels.title: Big staircase
levels.tip: Rocks line the stairs. One Repeat is all you need.

levels.title: Square dance
levels.tip: A Repeat can go inside another Repeat.

levels.title: Zigzag road
levels.tip: Find the pattern that repeats, then put it inside Repeat.

levels.title: Warm up first
levels.tip: Some blocks come before the Repeat.

levels.title: Down the steps
levels.tip: Count how many times the pattern happens.

levels.title: Factory finale
levels.tip: Mix plain blocks and Repeat blocks.

levels.title: Double staircase
levels.tip: Two staircases need two Repeat blocks. Turn between them.

levels.title: First gem
levels.tip: Stand on the gem and use Pick gem, then carry on to the battery.

levels.title: Gem trail
levels.tip: Repeat can pick up a whole trail of gems.

levels.title: Meet Function F
levels.tip: Build the function F once, then call it whenever you need it.

levels.title: Function with a loop
levels.tip: A function can have a Repeat inside it.

levels.title: Spiral gems
levels.tip: You can call F from inside a Repeat.

levels.title: Gem staircase
levels.tip: Put one step in F, then call it three times.

levels.title: Mow the lawn
levels.tip: Use F for each row, and turn between the rows.

levels.title: Gem ladder
levels.tip: Combine Repeat, F and Pick gem.

levels.title: Around the crystal
levels.tip: Four calls of F make a loop around the crystal.

levels.title: Space station
levels.tip: Plan first: which part repeats? Put that in F.
